output.reason: The evidence supports that the “Reserve Bank of India (Pre-payment Charges on Loans) Directions, 2025” is withdrawn/repealed and “on 2026-11-23 it is no longer in force.” However, it does not specifically establish that this 2025 directions contained “floating-rate pre-payment prohibitions,” nor that those particular prohibitions would no longer “control this case.” Therefore, only the general point that the 2025 directions are no longer in force is supported; the “floating-rate pre-payment prohibitions” and “do not control this case” parts are not fully supported by the evidence provided.
